label: Roguelike
description: Solo runs through sealed rooms on a map with rl_* markers (stage 1 probe, root-0042): a hub pad starts a run, each cleared room offers teleporters to the next, 3 lives. One player per room, several runs at once. Other maps are untouched. The game runs in warmup. The instance needs g_teamForceBalance 0, g_friendlyFire 0, g_infiniteAmmo 1 and g_teamSizeMin 1.

commands.name: rl
commands.description: Shows your room, lives and run time.

commands.name: rlroom
commands.description: Starts or moves your run into a room, for tests.
